title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks” | TechCrunch
summary: On Friday, OpenAI said that it will train its models using cached copies and simulated versions of the internet instead of the live web because the models are too unpredictable to be trusted with live internet access.
